title: Rule
description: Front matter schema for AGF-NG rules-template rule files

id.description: Kebab-case rule identifier. Unique within the rules-template.

applies_to.description: Which actor types this rule constrains.

evidence.description: Learning ID, codename, or citation that justifies this rule.

upstream_candidate.description: True if this rule is ready to propose back to the upstream framework.

strength.description: Obligation strength. Defaults to MUST if omitted.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Defaults to active if omitted.
